lines.text: You had something to do with that.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Does this mean you stop telling me what to do?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: You can choose your own path now.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: You know I can take care of myself.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Knowing does not stop me from asking.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: You inherited that answer from somewhere.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I am allowed to look at my own child.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I remember. You do it your own way now.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Do you remember the way back?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: You do not have to follow me.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I am going the same direction.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: You range farther than you used to.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I know how to come back.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I found a route you never showed me.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Good. Not every path needs to come from me.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I was still going to ask.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: You checked on me before yourself again.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I have no idea who you mean.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I still like coming back here.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Good. You always have a place here.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: You have your own habits now.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: This place feels smaller than it used to.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: You used to sleep right beside me.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I am now that you have checked.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: You have been following me around.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Then moving over should be easy.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: It is better when we are both home.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I was wondering where you went.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: You always come back to the same place.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: You are taking up more room than usual.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Maybe when you finish your own job.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: We keep ending up on the same tasks.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Stay where I can find you.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: You are walking too far ahead.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Even when I choose the route?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: That does not make it good.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I lost sight of you for a moment.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Next time, try not to run into danger first.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Good. I did not want to argue.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: That is why I am saying it now.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I hate seeing you stuck resting.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I needed to say it anyway.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: You will be fine without me for a while?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Do not make me wait that long again.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I kept expecting you to appear.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I was busy worrying about you.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: We do not have to talk.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I was not planning to leave.
